name: revit.place_family
description: Places a family instance in the active Revit document. Supports point-based, wall-based, face-based, and work-plane-based placement. Requires explicit family_name and family_type_name — never silently substitutes.

family_type_name.description: Name of the family type/symbol (e.g. '0915 x 2134mm')

location.description: Placement point [X, Y, Z] in feet

level_name.description: Name of the level to place on. If omitted, uses the lowest level.

hosting_behavior.description: How the family is hosted. Defaults to PointBased.

host_element_id.description: Element ID of the host element (required for WallBased placement)

rotation.description: Rotation angle in radians around the Z axis at the placement point

facing_orientation.description: Facing orientation vector [X, Y, Z] (informational, used for replay matching)

structural_usage.description: Structural usage: NonStructural, Beam, Column, Brace, etc.

examples.description: Place a chair at a specific point
